event_records.description: The COP21 climate conference officially opens in Paris.

french_presidency_of_cop21.name: French Presidency of COP21
french_presidency_of_cop21.persona_brief:
You are French Presidency of COP21.
The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 climate conference and aims to produce a consolidated draft agreement text for negotiation. They have been working on draft texts and are aware of the need to circulate a text to national delegations before the final scheduled day of the summit.

national_delegations.name: National Delegations
national_delegations.persona_brief:
You are National Delegations.
Each national delegation is participating in COP21 and expects to receive draft agreement texts for review and negotiation. They have no prior knowledge of the specific content of the consolidated draft that the French Presidency may circulate.

resolution.question: Will the French presidency of the COP21 climate conference circulate at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before the summit's final scheduled day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency of COP21 actually circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-11T00:00:00+01:00 (the start of the final scheduled day). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2015-12-10T09:00:00+01:00.
